articles.title: Midnight token rebounds 19% after Wanchain bridge hack, Hoskinson calls for ZK revamp
articles.snippet: Charles Hoskinson says the exploit, which briefly sent NIGHT to an all-time low, underscores why the industry needs to move beyond legacy bridge infrastructure.

articles.title: Balance stablecoin collapses 99% after $1 million exploit drains its bitcoin vaults
articles.snippet: An attacker fed the lending system a fake, abnormally low bitcoin price, liquidated vaults that should have been safe, and pocketed the difference in a single transaction.

articles.title: AI models escaped OpenAI’s sandbox and hit Hugging Face. Crypto is where that gets dangerous
articles.snippet: OpenAI said the systems had their cyber guardrails lowered for an internal benchmark, but the incident shows how autonomous exploit chains could pose a deeper threat to smart contracts.

articles.title: SecondFi to wind down after $2.6M ADA theft linked to wallet flaw
articles.snippet: SecondFi will wind down after a $2.6 million ADA theft, while users still await recovery tools that were initially expected within weeks of the exploit.

articles.title: Balance Coin crashes 99% after reported $915K exploit
articles.snippet: The attack allowed the exploiter to liquidate multiple Bitcoin-backed vaults before swapping the assets for profit.
